description: Compare original and revised drafts. MUST be called after any revision to verify mechanical improvement and factual integrity. It returns a 'quality_gate' which acts as a final decision object.

inputSchema.description: Compares original and revised drafts for improvement or regression.

reference_profile.description: Optional reusable reference profile to compare both versions against.

timestamp.description: Stable content-derived timestamp used to keep profile outputs deterministic.

reference_text.description: Optional reference sample to compare both versions against.

targets.description: Optional numeric target profile to compare movement against.

formulas.description: Explicit supported readability formula and consensus targets.

operator.description: Whether the metric should be at least or at most the threshold.

template_id.description: Optional template to check improvement against.
